verdict.rationale: Notte publishes an API reference with Bearer-token authentication for all requests and documented endpoints such as agent-start, used to create cloud browser sessions, scrape pages, and run web agents. Sessions are documented as programmatically controllable, scripts can be deployed as invocable API endpoints, and sessions expose a CDP endpoint. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), no independent or hands-on corroboration of direct API use, and little endpoint-level detail beyond auth and agent-start in the evidence.
